subject: Controlled Penpot visual PNG acceptance
body: Continue from the successful real-child image transport. Use execute_code with the correct Penpot 2.13 plugin API to create a clearly visible diagnostic rectangle: const r=penpot.createRectangle(); r.name='DORE_VISUAL_PROBE'; r.x=100; r.y=100; r.resize(320,180); r.fills=[{fillColor:'#FF5533',fillOpacity:1}]; return {id:r.id,name:r.name,type:r.type,width:r.width,height:r.height}; Then call export_shape on that exact returned ID with format png and mode shape. Require a real image block. Send that image to visual verification. If the verifier fails, inspect the image/export evidence and retry with a larger rectangle (640x360) and a text shape if supported. Do not use createShape or deleteNode. Do not stop on a plan. Success criterion: actual PNG image_count>0 and visual verifier PASS on a clearly visible diagnostic shape.
design_brief: Diagnostic acceptance only. The rendered image must visibly contain a solid #FF5533 rectangle named DORE_VISUAL_PROBE; blank/transparent output fails.
